meta.description: Kiezruf: report problems in your neighbourhood on the spot and back them with “Me too”.
nav.label: Main navigation
signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: You do not need an account to look around. To report, comment, follow or vote “Me too”, sign in with your email address. The same account works in the app.
signin.privacy: We will send you a 6-digit code. Your email address is never shown publicly.
signin.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
browse.title: Reports in Berlin
browse.empty: There are no reports here that match the filters.
filters.label: Filters
map.label: Map
map.listAlternative: The list contains the same reports as the map.
map.failed: The map could not be loaded. The list shows all reports.
meToo.hint: “Me too” only counts on the spot. Your browser will ask for your location.
detail.label: Report
detail.title: Report
detail.pickBody: Choose a report in the list or on the map to see photos, status and comments.
detail.notFoundBody: This report does not exist or is not public yet.
comments.flagged: Thanks, we will review this comment.
comments.held: Your comment is held for review before it appears.
notLive.title: Kiezruf is not live here yet
notLive.body: No office takes reports through Kiezruf at this place yet.
notLive.bodyNamed: {tenant} does not take reports through Kiezruf yet.
notLive.notifyMe: Tell me when it starts here
notLive.subscribed: We will email you as soon as Kiezruf starts here.
compose.title: Report a problem
compose.intro: Reports are made on the spot. You see the receiving office before you post.
compose.onSiteNote: Photos without location and time in their file are saved as a draft in this browser only. Finish them in the app when you are back on site.
compose.suggested: Suggested from your photo: {category}. You can choose a different category.
compose.locationHint: Your browser will ask for your precise location now. It is used for this report only.
compose.accuracyAdvice: Wait a moment or step outside, then try again. An accuracy of {max} m or better is needed.
compose.photosHint: 1 to {max} photos. Only photos with location and capture time in the file, taken in the last {hours} hours.
compose.draftExplain: At least one photo does not meet the on-site rules. Remove it, or save the report as a draft in this browser.
photos.tooMany: At most {max} photos per report. Further photos were not added.
photo.reason.no_metadata: Location or capture time is missing from the file: draft only.
photo.reason.capture_in_future: The capture time is in the future: draft only.
photo.reason.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported (JPEG, PNG or HEIC).
emergency.title: In an emergency, call right away:
emergency.note: Kiezruf is not an emergency service. Reports are not read around the clock.
pin.atCapture: The pin is at your location.
pin.moved: The pin is {distance} from your location (at most {max} m).
review.missingIntro: Before posting, this is still missing:
review.missingLive: a place where Kiezruf is live
review.photoDraftOnly: photos that meet the on-site rules (step 2)
posted.title: Report posted
posted.processing: Faces and number plates are being blurred now. After that the report appears on the map.
posted.following: You follow the report automatically and hear about every status change.
dup.title: Already reported?
dup.intro.one: There is already a similar report nearby. If it is the same problem, add your photo to give it more weight.
dup.intro.other: There are already {count} similar reports nearby. If one is the same problem, add your photo to give it more weight.
dup.join: Add my photo to this report
dup.joinExplain: You become a co-reporter and follow the report. The same on-site rules apply as for posting.
dup.joinedTitle: Your photo was added to the report
dup.joinedBody: You are now a co-reporter of this report and follow it:
drafts.title: Drafts in this browser
drafts.explain: Drafts stay in this browser only. You cannot post them from here; take new photos on the spot.
drafts.saved: Saved as a draft in this browser.
myReports.title: My reports
myReports.signInWhy: Sign in to see your reports.
myReports.empty: You have not reported anything yet.
myReports.notPublicYet: Not public yet: faces and number plates are being blurred or the report is being reviewed.
myReports.rejectedNote: This report was rejected and is not public.
following.title: Followed reports
following.intro: We notify you about every status change of these reports.
following.signInWhy: Sign in to see the reports you follow.
following.empty: You do not follow any report yet.
account.title: Account
account.signInWhy: Sign in to manage your account.
account.notificationsExplain: On the web we notify you by email. Phone notifications are set in the app.
account.emailStatusChange: Status changes of reports I follow
account.emailGoLive: Kiezruf starting in places I asked about
account.deleteExplain: Your account is deleted at once. Public reports and comments stay and then show “a neighbour”. Your email address is removed within 30 days.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out on every device.
account.deleted: Your account is deleted. You are signed out.

console.map.failed: The map could not be loaded.
console.signin.title: Staff sign-in
console.signin.intro: Sign in to the municipal console with your work email address and a code from your authenticator app.
console.signin.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the current code for Kiezruf.
console.signin.mfaAgain: You are signed in. For the console, confirm your sign-in with the code from your authenticator app at least every 12 hours.
console.signin.enrollIntro: This is your first sign-in. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example FreeOTP, Aegis or the app your office uses).
console.signin.enrollManual: If you cannot scan, enter this key in the app by hand:
console.signin.enrollConfirm: Then enter the first code from the app to finish the setup.
console.signin.qrAlt: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
console.signin.qrFailed: The QR code could not be created. Enter the key by hand.
console.scope.label: Scope

console.queue.captionScore: Reports, sorted by score, highest first

console.report.notFoundBody: This report does not exist or is outside your scope.
console.report.photoAlt: Photo {n} of {total} for the report "{category}", faces and plates blurred
console.report.original: Open the original of photo {n} (link expires soon)
console.report.readOnly: Read-only. Only the owning tenant changes this report; forwarded reports stay visible here.
console.report.readOnlyRole: Read-only. Your role can view reports but not change them.
console.breakdown.title: Score breakdown
console.breakdown.caption: How the score is made up
console.breakdown.discounted: ({count} from new accounts counted at half weight)
console.breakdown.rules: Unique accounts only. Danger ×1.5 from 3 confirmations, ×1.2 for 1–2; safety category ×1.3.
console.breakdown.missing: No breakdown is available for this report.
console.actions.title: Actions
console.status.title: Change status
console.status.label: New status
console.status.publicNoteHint: Citizens see this text on the report. Followers are notified.
console.override.title: Override level
console.override.reasonHint: The reason appears in the history.
console.override.cleared: The level follows the score again.
console.forward.title: Forward
console.forward.none: There is nowhere to forward this report.
console.forward.noteHint: Tells citizens where the report went.
console.forward.targetRequired: Please choose where to forward the report.
console.forward.done: Forwarded. The report stays visible here, read-only.
console.merge.title: Merge a duplicate
console.merge.hint: Enter or pick the number, for example BE-NK-2026-0112. Same tenant only.
console.merge.invalidId: That is not a valid report number.
console.merge.sameReport: A report cannot be merged into itself.
console.merge.confirmBody: {from} will be merged into {into}. Votes, follows and comments move without double counting. Whoever reported {from} becomes a co-reporter.
console.spike.title: Unusual voting
console.spike.rule: Rule: more than 10 votes in 60 minutes, more than half from accounts younger than 7 days. When confirmed, votes from new accounts count at half weight.
console.spike.confirm: Count new accounts at half weight
console.spike.confirmed: Confirmed: votes from new accounts count at half weight.
console.spike.isConfirmed: Confirmed: votes from new accounts count at half weight.
console.comments.title: Comments
console.ban.title: Ban the author's account
console.history.title: History
console.history.overrideCleared: Override cleared: the level follows the score
console.moderation.title: Flagged & moderation
console.moderation.readOnly: Your role can only read here.
console.moderation.heldExplain: These reports are not public because blurring faces and plates failed.
console.moderation.heldExplainReasons: These reports are not public. The reason is shown with each report.
console.moderation.heldReason.blur_faile: Blurring faces and number plates failed
console.account.title: Your settings
console.account.briefingEmail: Weekly briefing by email on Mondays
console.account.briefingEmailHint: Every Monday at 07:00 to tenant admins, with the same items and links as here.
console.account.emailOn: You will get the weekly briefing by email.
console.account.emailOff: You will no longer get the weekly briefing by email.
console.account.emailAdminsOnly: The weekly briefing email goes to tenant admins only. You read it here in the console.
console.briefing.title: Weekly briefing
console.briefing.none: There is no briefing for this level yet.
console.briefing.noneExplain: Briefings are written every Monday at 07:00 for each live tenant and for roll-up levels.
console.briefing.aiExplain: Built only from scores, hotspots, trends and comments in your scope. Every point links to its reports. Check before acting.
console.briefing.fallbackExplain: No AI briefing with valid citations could be written this week. These are the reports with the highest score instead.
console.briefing.ratingSaved: Thanks, your rating has been saved.
console.hotspots.title: Hotspots
console.hotspots.explain: Reports within 150 m and in the same category group form a hotspot. Colour and symbol show the highest level inside, size the number of reports. The table holds the same data.
console.hotspots.empty: There are no hotspots here right now.
console.hotspots.caption: Hotspots with level, category group, number of reports, recurrence and reports
console.hotspots.mapCaption: Map of hotspots. Size = number of reports.
console.hotspots.mapFailed: The map could not be loaded. The table lists every hotspot.
console.trends.title: Trends
console.trends.empty: There were no reports here in the last 8 weeks.
console.trends.explain: Reports per week, {from} to {to}. Every chart uses the same scale. The change compares the latest week with the average of the 4 weeks before it.
console.trends.caption: Reports per week and category, with the 4-week average and the latest week's change
console.trends.vsAverage: Latest week against the 4-week average of {average}
console.export.title: Export for council meetings
console.export.scope: For {tenant} and everything below it in your scope.
console.export.badRange: The end date is before the start date.
console.export.rangeHint: Without dates the export holds every report.
console.suggest.title: Possible duplicates
console.suggest.explain: Reports of the same tenant within 150 m and the same category group, by photo similarity.
console.suggest.readOnly: Only staff who may change this report can merge.
console.tenants.title: Tenants & roles
console.tenants.empty: There are no tenants in your scope.
console.tenants.readOnly: Read-only. Tenant admins change their own tenant; platform admins change the tree.
console.tenants.thresholdsHint: The level applies from this score. Critical must be above High, High above Medium.
console.tenants.thresholdsInvalid: Thresholds must be above 0 with Critical > High > Medium.
console.contacts.title: External contacts for forwarding
console.contacts.explain: Forwarded reports go to these contacts by email, with a link that needs no login.
console.contacts.name: Name
console.contacts.removeBody: {name} will no longer receive forwarded reports.
console.staff.title: Staff at this node
console.staff.empty: Nobody. Access comes from a level above.
